title: Google Ads For Photographers: How My Business Grew 450%

facts.fact: The author estimated that running Google Ads would cost about $300 a month.
facts.quote: It was going to cost about **$300 a month**, and at that point my photography business was bringing in around **$11,000 a year

facts.fact: Before starting Google Ads, the author's photography business was bringing in around $11,000 a year, per the author's own account.
facts.quote: my photography business was bringing in around **$11,000 a year (it was a rough start after moving cities)**

facts.fact: In the first year the author ran Google Ads (2020), the author's income increased by about 55%, per the author's own account.
facts.quote: The first year I ran Google Ads, my income increased by about **55%**. And this was during 2020

facts.fact: Over several years of using Google Ads, the author's photography business grew by more than 450%, per the author's own account.
facts.quote: using **Google Ads for photographers** helped my business grow by **more than 450%**.

facts.fact: According to the author, research from Google states that billions of searches happen every day, many from people actively looking for local services.
facts.quote: According to research from Google, billions of searches happen every day, many of them from people actively looking for local services.
